              Controls

              • W A S D / arrowsWalk (or click the ground)
              • EnterChat
              • I or 3Backpack: everything you own
              • 1, 2Shovel, fishing rod
              • HRide your board (in the crypt: drink a potion)
              • EUse what you are standing by: signs, seats, chests, furniture, doors
              • Click waterCast your line there
              • TThrow something (then click where)
              • FStrike on a bite, or pull the line in (decorating: flip a piece)
              • Space, A, DFish on: reel in, pull the rod left or right
              • RDecorating: turn a piece
              • SpaceCrypt: attack your target
              • 1, 2, 3Crypt: your skills
              • MCrypt: mana potion
              • BCrypt: Backpack, weapons
              • EscClose a card

              The globe in the bar opens the map: click a place to go there. The clock holds today's quests and your daily rewards, The Wando Times (today's news, the hunt and the Hall of Fame), the Prize Wheel and the camera.

              The smiley button: moves (wave, dance, sit, jump, cheer, spin), Throw!, and 16 emoticons. Or type :) <3 :D ;) :( gg on their own in chat. Your title (under your name) is picked on your profile card.

                                Kickflip Skate Shop

                                Coins: 100

                                  Six new deck designs arrive every Monday, and the old ones leave the wall. Decks you buy are yours to keep: find them in the Wardrobe (slot 3) under My boards. Press H or the Ride button to hop on; Space pops an ollie.

                                  Cupcake Chaos

                                  Coins: 100

                                  Level 1

                                  Quick reminder of the job
                                  1. Drag a waiting group to a table (or click the group, then the table).
                                  2. When they wave (!), click the table to take the order, then click ORDERS to hang the slip.
                                  3. Click a cake on the counter, then the table with its number.
                                  4. Click the table for the money ($), click it again to clear it, then click DISHES.

                                  You have two hands. The same job several times in a row is a chain: double, triple and more. A guest on a chair of their own colour is a bonus. Hearts are patience: at none, they walk out.

                                      How fishing works

                                        Rod rack

                                        Coins: 100

                                          Fish on!

                                          Line tension
                                          Fish stamina
                                          Line out

                                          Hold Space (or the button, or the water) to reel. A and D (or the arrows) pull the rod left and right: pull against the fish to turn it and tire it. Let go when it runs or jumps. Too tight snaps the line; too slack and it throws the hook; let it run too far and it takes all your line.
